summary: Fold orientation on Lagena tests can be scored from images: GBIF holds 1,567 Lagena occurrence records with still images (genus key 3211203), and foraminifera.eu and bforams@mikrotax serve illustrations, though both catalogue sites are client-rendered and not queryable by plain HTTP. No source records wall thickness relative to diameter, MorphoSource has no Lagena or hydroid scans (0 hits; 75 foraminifera media overall), and nothing was found for tubular hydroid gonangia, so the thick-neck half of the claim has no data.
next_step: Compile a scored image set from GBIF Lagena media (costae longitudinal vs annular, by body region) and seek micro-CT of Lagena for wall-thickness/diameter ratios (Zenodo foraminifera micro-CT sets as a protocol model); hydroid gonangia need new SEM/sections.
obstacles_confirmed: Most catalog images do not report wall thickness, so the stiffness variable has to be inferred or measured from a subset of sections and micro-CT.
Hydroid gonangia are not in the foraminiferal archives (and not in MorphoSource or Dryad either).
